name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, March 25, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
6.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meetings held on March 11, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 6b
c.
Resolution 2015-13, Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item 6c
d.
Consideration of a Support Letter for SB485 (Los Angeles County Sanitation Districts: Storm Water Authority)
ACTION: Direct the Mayor to sign the attached letter of support and transmit it to Senators Ed Hernandez, Carol Liu, and Ben Allen, and State Assembly Members Anthony Rendon, Christina Garcia, and David Hadley.
Item 6d
e.
Possible rescheduling of the May 13, 2015 Council meeting.
ACTION: That the May 13, 2015 meeting be rescheduled to May 11 or May 12.
Item 6e
f.
Approval of a Professional Services Agreement (PSA) with KEC Engineers, Inc. for Design Services for the intersection improvements at Western Avenue/Palos Verde Drive North and Pacific Coast Highway/Walnut Street.
That the City Council:
ACTION: 1) Approve a Professional Services Agreement with KEC Engineers, Inc., for a not to exceed amount of $85,980 for design services for the intersection improvements at Western Avenue/Palos Verde Drive North and Pacific Coast Highway/Walnut Street; and 2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement; and 3) authorize a 10% contingency for unforeseen design services, for a total design budget of $94,578.
Item 6f
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
7.
ADOPT THE RECOMMENDED LIST OF STREET FOR ASPHALT ZIPPER ACTION: That the City Council adopt the attached list of streets for pavement repairs through use of the Asphalt Zipper (Asphalt Zipper Street List).
Item 7
8.
SHERIFF'S QUARTERLY REPORT ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 8
9.
STUDY SESSION - CITYWIDE COMPREHENSIVE USER FEES AND CHARGES That the City Council:
ACTION: 1) Review the proposed user fees and charges; 2) Provide any changes to the recommended fee schedules; and 3) Direct staff to schedule a public hearing on April 22, 2015.
Item 9
10.
ADJOURNMENT In memory of Margaret Grant, a member of the Lomita Manor family since 1997.
The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on April 8, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
